# Grading System

![](/media/uploads/2025/02/a-f3.png)

#### **The Restoration of Education grading system is based on a variety of measurements listed here:**

- Number of opportunities for school choice or alternative programs
- Whether state tax dollars follow the student
- The ability to homeschool without government interference.

To receive an “A”, the state must show a large number of students receiving state tax dollars to fund their education program of choice and permit homeschooling or religious exemptions without government interference. Grading evaluations are conducted by a research team and experts in the field of education policy.
